newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl hands back Rolex from Denver summit.
newsitem.headline: Kohl hands back Rolex from Denver summit.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl plans to return a Rolex watch offered to world leaders at the G7 summit in Denver last week, a government spokesman said on Wednesday.
Kohl, who had already turned down a pair of cowboy boots presented by U.S. President Bill Clinton, plans to send back the Rolex watch he was given last week.

"The Chancellor has no intention of accepting this gift and will return it to the Rolex company," a Bonn spokesman said on Wednesday, referring to the luxury timepiece given to him by the Swiss manufacturer.

The German leader had earlier given his counterparts a lesson in the simple life by shunning the black Mercedes, Cadillacs and other state limousines on offer in Denver to travel to and fro sessions on an ordinary tour bus.
